data.name: richTextBox1.Text
data.value:
Live stream from a YouTube link, direct link on YouTube, m3u8 link, Twitch, Facebook, Dailymotion,... without needing to get the link
Basic guide: Click Loop Infinitive if you want the live stream to loop continuously If the live stream is stuttering, lagging, or the stream speed is not enough 1x, click non filter to fix some of it.
If live streaming from a link fails (it opens then closes immediately), use the "Get Link!" function above the Input. Then just paste the link you got into the Input to solve the problem.
If the tool does not automatically get the link or get link fails, please update the latest youtube-dl version at: "http://youtube-dl.org" then replace the old youtube-dl version in the tool.
Only choose "Fix Non Filter" when clicking Non Filter and the program does not run.
If you get a missing MSVCR100.dll error, install: https://www.microsoft.com/en-US/download/details.aspx?id=5555
Install .NET 4.7 to ensure the tool runs smoothly https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/download/details.aspx?id=55167
